summary: A former candidate builds a radio audience between campaigns.
realLife: After two unsuccessful House campaigns, Mike Pence hosted a statewide radio show and later left it to run for Congress.
inGame: needs: a broadcast job between two candidacies with dates for leaving the program and filing.

turns.what: The host renews the program when a seat opens.
turns.pulledBy: The station offers another season and filing would end the job.
turns.writesBack: The host stays on the schedule through the election.

turns.what: The host leaves the program to explore a run and lets the deadline pass.
turns.pulledBy: The host cannot assemble enough support to file.
turns.writesBack: The broadcast job ends without a new candidacy.
